name: yobachat
description: OBS chat widget for Twitch, YouTube, and Telegram

scripts.prod:update-main: git pull origin main && npm run prod:build:all && npm run prod:pm2:restart
scripts.prod:build:all: npm run prod:build:server && npm run prod:build:client
scripts.prod:build:server: npm run clean:server && cd server && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --external:uWebSockets.js --external:tmi.js --external:node-telegram-bot-api --external:ws --external:express --external:youtubei.js --external:jsonwebtoken --external:pm2
scripts.dev:build:all: npm run dev:build:server && npm run dev:build:client
scripts.dev:build:server: npm run clean:server && cd server && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --external:uWebSockets.js --external:tmi.js --external:node-telegram-bot-api --external:ws --external:express --external:youtubei.js --external:jsonwebtoken --external:pm2
scripts.dev:build:server:watch: npm run clean:server && cd server && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --sourcemap --external:uWebSockets.js --external:tmi.js --external:node-telegram-bot-api --external:ws --external:express --external:youtubei.js --external:jsonwebtoken --external:pm2 --watch
scripts.dev:build:client: cd client && cross-env SHARED_CONFIG_PATH=./shared/shared-config.dev.json NODE_ENV=development vite build
scripts.dev:build:client:watch: cd client && cross-env SHARED_CONFIG_PATH=./shared/shared-config.dev.json NODE_ENV=development vite build --watch
scripts.dev:start:server: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development SERVER_CONFIG_PATH=./server-config.dev.json SHARED_CONFIG_PATH=./shared/shared-config.dev.json node dist/index.js
